# SD18 deterministic Human Wizard level 20 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Wizard
# level-1..level-19 prepared arcane spell-bearing baseline
# (tests/fixtures/rules_core/pf1_human_wizard_level19_sd18_widening_deterministic_input.txt)
# to level 20 as chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain
# derived, computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human
# race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic
# ability/feat posture from the level-1 through level-19 fixtures, and the
# same canonical school specialization selections (Evocation chosen,
# Necromancy/Transmutation opposed), adding only the level bump this bounded
# slice needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Wizard burden surface: no evocation
# spell-damage application, no force-missile casting execution, no
# opposed-school preparation cost, no spellbook, no spells prepared, no spell
# slots, no spell DCs, and no bonus-feat selection/execution for the
# still-unproven 5th/10th/15th/20th-level "Bonus feat" grant. Two PF1 CRB
# primary sources (d20pfsrd.com and the Archives of Nethys aonprd.com
# mirror) were read directly (raw curl fetch + a small Python tag-stripper,
# not AI-summarized) before writing this fixture, fetching the full
# levels-16-through-20 block in one pass so the level-20 row's neighbors
# were visible in context (guards against level-misattribution), and both
# agree byte-for-byte: base attack bonus genuinely RISES to +10
# (20 / 2 = 10, up from +9 at level 19); good Will genuinely RISES to +12
# (20 / 2 + 2 = 12, up from +11 at level 19); poor Fortitude/Reflex both STAY
# at +6 (20 / 3 = 6, an integer-division coincidence with level 19).
# The raw Wizard spells-per-day table's level-20 row is
# "4/4/4/4/4/4/4/4/4/4" — up from the level-19 row "4/4/4/4/4/4/4/4/3/3" (the
# 8th- and 9th-level columns both rise to 4), but NO genuinely new
# spell-level column opens (9th is already the highest wizard spell level in
# PF1, first opened at level 17), so the specialist bonus-slot flat count
# (one bonus slot of each spell level she can cast, 1st through 9th) STAYS
# at 9, unchanged from levels 17-19. Intense Spells' bonus-damage magnitude
# genuinely RISES to 10 (max(20/2, 1) = 10, up from 9 at level 19) via the
# pre-existing formula, not re-derived; Force Missile's uses-per-day pool
# stays level-independent and unchanged; Scribe Scroll and the school
# specialization choice stay recognized as already-held grants.
# The level-20 "Special" column reads "Bonus feat" on both primary sources
# (byte-for-byte agreement) — the SAME genuinely open-ended
# metamagic/item-creation/Spell-Mastery choice already left
# named-but-unproven at levels 5, 10, and 15 (verified: the class table's
# own "Bonus Feats" ability text, "At 5th, 10th, 15th, and 20th level, a
# wizard gains a bonus feat. At each such opportunity, he can choose a
# metamagic feat, an item creation feat, or Spell Mastery," is identical
# wording across both sources and names no new mechanic at 20th level), so
# it stays deliberately named-but-unproven and no new pillar record is
# grounded at level 20. (A separate, non-Core-Rulebook "Well-Prepared"
# alternate capstone exists on both sources but is explicitly sourced to
# Pathfinder Player Companion: Chronicle of Legends, an optional splatbook
# replacement a player may pick instead of the standard ability — out of
# SD18's Core Rulebook scope, not part of the default level-20 Wizard row,
# and not used by this fixture.) This is the final level within PF1's 1-20
# character-level cap for this class row.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-wizard-level20-sd18-widening
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:wizard:20
ability=strength:8
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:17
ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:10
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:wizard_school_specialization:school:evocation
choice=choice:wizard_opposed_schools:school:necromancy
choice=choice:wizard_opposed_schools:school:transmutation
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:intelligence
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-18-core-rules-breadth/scope-draft.md
